{{Top|leg}}
The '''Golan Ribbon tanker''' was a type of [[Refueling tanker|fuel tanker]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a Golan Ribbon tanker was refueling a Rebel task force above [[Turkana/Legends|Turkana]] when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet attacked the Rebel ships, engaging the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]].
